rows.label: Mastery Rank 5
rows.note: needed to create a Kuva Lich

rows.label: Rising Tide
rows.note: quest complete; gives you a Railjack

rows.label: Railjack Intrinsics rank 5
rows.note: any one Intrinsic; opens Saturn Proxima for the final fight

conditions: You can have only one adversary at a time. Clear or convert any Lich, Sister, or Coda before starting.

groups.place: KUVA SIPHON OR KUVA FLOOD, ANY
groups.activity: earn and crack Requiem Eterna Relics

rows.label: Oull
rows.note: wildcard Requiem; optional, only one can be equipped
rows.alt: the first time you land the full correct sequence, 25% to drop

conditions: A Kuva Flood always drops an Eterna Relic, a Kuva Siphon 50% of the time, and each Thrall 5%.
Open them in a Requiem Fissure on the Kuva Fortress. They cannot be refined with Void Traces and hold only the eight Requiem mods, never Oull.
Each solved sequence uses one charge from every equipped mod. A mod with no charges is Defiled and unusable.
Palladino sells the retired Requiem I-IV relics for 10 Riven Slivers each, 10 per week of each.

disclosures.title: stock mods before the Lich spawns
disclosures.body: A Lich stays until you solve its sequence, so have a pool of Requiem mods ready before you Mercy a Larvling.

groups.activity: Capture; spawn and inspect Kuva Larvlings
groups.meta: at most 21 Larvlings to land a chosen weapon

rows.label: Kuva Nukor Larvling
rows.note: weapon preview must say Kuva Nukor

rows.label: progenitor of choice
rows.note: its element becomes the weapon's bonus damage and sets the Lich's abilities
rows.alt: Elemental Vice swaps the element later at rank 40

conditions: Run any regular level 20+ Grineer mission. When the screen flashes, kill at least 10 enemies within a minute to spawn the Larvling; each extra squadmate raises the count. On a Capture the flash comes after the target is captured.
Stand within 3 meters of the downed Larvling to see its weapon. If it is not the Nukor, skip it and finish the mission.
Only the last player to damage it can Mercy it (hold X), so run solo. You cannot Mercy while any Lich, Sister, or Coda is active.
Fissures, Invasions, quests, and Dark Sectors never spawn Larvlings; Steel Path missions do.
bonuses: Everyone in the squad gets 100 Kuva when a Larvling goes down, even if nobody Mercies it.

disclosures.title: the only reliable weapon reroll
disclosures.body: Finishing the mission without Mercy puts that weapon on a reject list, so it will not show again until every weapon has appeared. Aborting does not count. Taking any weapon clears the list. Skip every Larvling that is not the Nukor.

disclosures.title: other nodes
disclosures.body: Cassini is a quick Capture. Exterminate nodes such as Telesto also work and have many enemies to kill for the count.

groups.activity: Mercy Thralls, reveal mods, and test the sequence
groups.meta: reveal all 3 Requiems, then find their order

rows.label: revealed Requiems
rows.note: Murmurs reveal the mods, not their order

rows.label: correct Parazon sequence
rows.note: sends the Lich to Saturn Proxima

conditions: Mercy Thralls (blue outline, red waypoint) on your Lich's red influence nodes. Each one adds a Murmur and fills your Lich's rage meter; Thralls on another Lich's node give Murmurs but no rage.
Do not stab your Lich until one Requiem is revealed. After that, equip the known mods on your Parazon and stab every time the Lich is down.
A wrong stab stops at the first wrong mod, ranks the Lich up (Earth, Mars, Ceres, Sedna, Kuva Fortress), and gives the squad 10 Murmurs.
Clearing every influenced node on a planet also ranks the Lich up.
Your Lich steals about 0.7% of your rewards per influenced node. You get it all back when it is defeated.
Down the Lich three times without stabbing and it leaves without ranking up.
bonuses: Each stab drops Kuva for the squad: 150, 200, 250, or 300 at Lich rank 1 to 4.
The first time you land the full correct sequence, 25% to drop Oull.
A Requiem Ultimatum forces your Lich out on one of its nodes. Palladino sells one a week for 10 Riven Slivers; use it solo, since a squad can spawn a teammate's Lich instead.

disclosures.title: the safe four-stab routine
disclosures.body: Put the first revealed Requiem in slot 1 with any two others behind it. If the stab fails, move it to slot 2, then slot 3. Put each later reveal in the first slot not ruled out. The fourth stab is guaranteed.

disclosures.title: the same routine with Oull
disclosures.body: Put Oull in slot 1 and the first known Requiem in slot 2; swap them if it fails. If the known one failed slot 1, move it to slot 3. Put the second reveal in the first unknown slot, and move it to slot 2 if it fails. The last stab fixes the order. Replace Oull with the third reveal once you have it.

disclosures.title: good Thrall missions
disclosures.body: Thralls spawn on a timer, up to 10 per mission. Survival, Defense, Excavation, and Interception give plenty. On Interception, Mercy every Thrall before 100% or the end of the mission clears them.

groups.activity: Railjack Skirmish; defeat the Lich and Vanquish it

rows.label: Kuva Nukor
rows.note: ready to claim in the Foundry

conditions: Clear the fighters and Gokstad Crewships, board the Grineer Galleon, and beat the Lich's single health bar.
Choose Vanquish, never Convert. No choice within 20 seconds Vanquishes.
The weapon ignores its normal Mastery Rank requirement.
bonuses: Everything your Lich taxed comes back, and a vanquish has a 25% chance to drop a Requiem Ultimatum.
If your Lich carries an Ephemera you get it, and the first vanquish earns the Old Blood Emblem.

disclosures.title: modding the Nukor
disclosures.body: Its base crit chance is low. Primed Pistol Gambit or Creeping Bullseye lift it to about 20% and 21%. Shoot corpses to chain the beam to other enemies.

rows.label: 60% bonus
rows.note: optional; the bonus rolls between 25% and 60%
rows.alt: stop at the first usable roll

conditions: Fusion gives 1.1 times the higher bonus, rounded down and capped at 60%. A result of 58% or more becomes 60%, so a donor at 52.8% or better finishes it.

Start from the Nukor you want to keep. Its Catalysts, Forma, Exilus adapter, Focus lens, and Elemental Vice stay; the donor's are lost. Claim the donor from the Foundry first, since unclaimed copies cannot be fused.
Elemental Vice swaps the bonus element only on a rank 40 weapon (5 Forma). It does not change the percentage.
bonuses: Fusion lets you pick which of the two elements survives.
Unclaimed copies in the Foundry sell for 10,000 credits.

disclosures.title: a 60% chase is several Liches
disclosures.body: The bonus rolls evenly from 25% to 60%, so 60% takes several full Lich cycles. A Kuva weapon gives Mastery only once, so extra copies are only for fusing.
